items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: we built a musician in Alexander, they called him Ollie. Ollie Williams or something like that... we just put in five and six dollars a piece... give him a big funeral

ctx.x: Well, when you were playing in different places all over the state, did they ever used to have brass bands for funerals in any place except here?

No, only in New Orleans. But, we built a musician in Alexander, they called him Ollie. Ollie Williams or something like that. He got killed by a train. And the musicians didn't have no union there, but they were all friends, they had a club like, you know. And this was a strange fella he comes out of shop somewhere. He didn't have no people and nothing so we just put in five and six dollars a piece, you know, give him a big funeral and got all the fellas in them different bands. We had about a 50 piece band to…
